blocks.prompt: 4 Find a unit vector in the direction of \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\).
blocks.explanation:
A unit vector has length 1 and the same direction as \(\underline{v}\).
We must find \(\hat{v} = \underline{v}/|\underline{v}|\).
Plan: find \(|\underline{v}|\), divide every component by it, and check the length is 1.
steps:
Given: \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\).
To find: the unit vector \(\hat{v}\) in the direction of \(\underline{v}\).
Method: \(\hat{v} = \dfrac{\underline{v}}{|\underline{v}|}\): dividing by the length makes the length 1 without changing direction.

Find \(|\underline{v}|\)
\[|\underline{v}| = \sqrt{(-1)^2 + 4^2 + (-8)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{1 + 16 + 64}\]
\[= \sqrt{81} = 9\]
Why: Magnitude formula; all squares are positive.

Divide by 9
\[\hat{v} = \dfrac{-\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}}{9}\]
\[= -\dfrac{1}{9}\underline{i} + \dfrac{4}{9}\underline{j} - \dfrac{8}{9}\underline{k}\]
Why: Each component is divided by the length.

Check the length
\[\dfrac{1}{81} + \dfrac{16}{81} + \dfrac{64}{81} = 1\]
\[|\hat{v}| = \sqrt{1} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Why: A unit vector must have length exactly 1.
